summary: Unfold the three matrices and compare entries; the identities follow from p p⁻¹ = 1, the rules of the involution and p p̄ = N.

steps.claim: Unfolding besselLatticeBasis, splitGram and middleGram turns the matrix identity into finitely many entrywise identities between expressions in p, p̄, p⁻¹, p̄⁻¹ and N.
Each entrywise identity holds: it follows from p·p⁻¹ = 1, conj(xy) = conj(x)conj(y), conj 1 = 1, conj(conj x) = x, conj 0 = 0 and the hypothesis p p̄ = N.
